Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 11, 2026, the Board of Directors of Clearwater Paper Corporation (the “Company”) appointed Matthew D. Passarello as the Company’s Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and designated him as the Company’s principal financial officer, effective November 14, 2026. Mr. Passarello has assumed the duties and responsibilities of CFO from Sherri Baker, who left the Company as of the close of business on November 13, 2026, as previously reported. Mr. Passarello, age 35, has served as Senior Vice President, Supply Chain and Corporate Development of the Company since January 2025. Mr. Passarello served the Company as Vice President of Corporate Strategy and Integration from April 2024 through December 2024. Before joining the Company, Mr. Passarello was Partner at McKinsey & Company in their paper and packaging practice. In addition to his consulting experience, Mr. Passarello led the transformation management office for recycled paperboard manufacturer Caraustar, now Greif (NYSE: GEF). Mr. Passarello earned his bachelor’s degrees in economics and statistics from the University of Georgia. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Passarello and any person other than the Company pursuant to which he was appointed as Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer. There is no family relationship between Mr. Passarello and any director or executive officer of the Company or any person nominated or chosen to become a director or executive officer of the Company. Mr. Passarello has no direct or indirect material interest in any transaction required to be disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. The Company and Mr. Passarello entered into an employment offer letter providing for, among other things, an annual base salary of $450,000 per year. His 2026 target cash bonus under the Company’s annual incentive award plan will remain 65% of his prior base salary of $390,000, increasing to 75% of his new base salary of $450,000 in 2027. Mr. Passarello will continue to participate in the Company’s existing Executive Severance Plan and Change of Control Plan for executive employees (as described in the Company’s most recent proxy statement). As a result of Mr. Passarello’s election as the Company’s Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, the Company intends to make certain changes to our functional and leadership structure. As part of the revised structure, Rebecca A. Barckley was appointed as the Company’s Vice President, Corporate Controller and Chief Accounting Officer, effective as of November 14, 2026. She continues as the Company’s designated principal accounting officer and reports to Mr. Passarello. Ms. Barckley, age 63, has served as Vice President, Corporate Controller of the Company since January 2020. Ms. Barckley also served as the Company’s Interim CFO from July 1, 2023 until August 14, 2023. Before joining the Company, Ms. Barckley worked for Louisiana Pacific Corporation (NYSE: LPX), a building materials manufacturer, where she spent 20 years in progressively increasing leadership roles in finance and accounting including, from 2010 through 2019, serving as its Corporate Controller Financial Reporting, Principal Accounting Officer. Ms. Barckley earned her Bachelor of Business Administration, Accounting from California State University, Fresno. There are no arrangements or understandings between Ms. Barckley and any person other than the Company pursuant to which she was appointed as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Corporate Controller. There is no family relationship between Ms. Barckley and any director or executive officer of the Company or any person nominated or chosen to become a director or executive officer of the Company. Ms. Barckley has no direct or indirect material interest in any transaction required to be disclosed pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. There will be no change to Ms. Barckley’s compensation as a result of her appointment as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Corporate Controller. Ms. Barckley will continue to participate in the Company’s existing Executive Severance Plan and Change of Control Plan for executive employees (as described in the Company’s most recent proxy statement). A copy of the press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Passarello and Ms. Barckley is furnished with the report as Exhibit 99.1.
